section.title: Laser lightmarkers
section.hierarchy_path: /System description/Scan unit (gantry)/Gantry operator panels/Gantry operator panel with Touch Panel/Laser lightmarkers

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Laser lightmarkers
This key turns on and off the laser lightmarkers.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
3 System description
The laser lightmarkers are laser beams that emanate from three marked points in the gantry opening. The laser beams create line marks. The beams can cross and create intersections.
The laser lightmarkers indicate the position of the scan center and the slice plane in the middle of the detector rows.
For interventional examinations, the laser lightmarkers are switched off automatically after approximately one minute.

You can optionally use the Auto Laser function to turn on or off the laser lightmarkers upon arriving at the start position. To activate the Auto Laser, in the settings popover on the Touch Panel go to General settings. ( Page 105 General settings)

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Touch Panel
The Touch Panel is part of the gantry operator panel. It displays scan parameters and can be used to control defined CT scanner functions.
Information icons display ( Page 103 Information icons display)
Scan parameters display ( Page 103 Scan parameters display)

Patient data display ( Page 103 Patient data display)
The Touch Panel screen saver cannot be stopped by touching the panel.
Stop the screen saver at your syngo Acquisition Workplace.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Line On/Off reset button

With the Line On/Off reset button, you can disconnect the entire system from the mains power supply immediately. After releasing the Line On/Off reset button, the system always returns to its previous state.

The system does not automatically check whether it is safe to shut down. If you need to disconnect the entire system, you must first close all open applications and, if possible, shut down the operating system at the console. Then press and hold the Line On/Off reset button on the gantry for approximately 10 seconds. After approximately 30 seconds, the system starts up automatically.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: RTP adaptor connections
For a standardized patient setup, the table top provides different mounting possibilities (indexing systems). ( Page 48 During system movements)
Slots along both sides of the RTP table top (for restraint straps)
Indentation (Interloc Indexing)
Bore hole
Plug connection for positioning aids
The indentations are used to mount adaptors.

The bore holes can be furnished with lens head screws. The screws are used to mount different accessories (for example, adaptors, rulers). The indexing systems are compatible with most of the accessories used in radiation therapy.
Screw sockets located on the foot end for external devices
For instructions using accessories see the instruction for use of the manufacturer.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 3.4.1 3D camera
The 3D camera produces an image of the patient structure in three dimensions and is equipped with an infrared light source and sensor as well as an RGB camera.
The 3D camera is positioned above the patient table. You can see the live image taken with the 3D camera on the Touch Panel.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
3 System description
The infrared sensor may interfere with other infrared devices, including remote controls. Do not use any other infrared devices at the same time as capturing a 3D image of the patient.
The infrared laser may affect the operation of other electronic equipment, causing them to malfunction.
Do not obstruct the view to the patient, so that the isocenter can be
accurately calculated.
The 3D camera is not intended for the positioning of infants and small children. Use
manual positioning with the internal laser lightmarkers instead.
For further instructions, refer to the Instructions for Use of the 3D camera manufacturer.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 3.5.3 Workplace computer
One workplace computer is delivered with your system.
The pictures shown here are only examples. The appearance of your device may be slightly different.
You use this computer to perform the following activities:
Controlling the CT scanner
Evaluating studies
Storing studies
The workplace computer provides several components, for example, USB ports, DVD recorder. The location and the design of these components may vary.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
3 System description
Do not use the Computer On/Off key. The computer must be switched on and off by using control box and software only.

If you switch off the computer via the Computer On/Off key, it is not able to receive the start-up signal from the control box. In this case, you need to press the Computer On/Off key again to switch on the computer.
